note_en: Goto Floating Wind Farm LLC's Feb 2022 project outline for MLIT (mlit.go.jp) has a diagram whose labels (rotor diameter / overall length / hub height / draft / water depth) and values (80 / 56 / 172 / 76 / 100 m) are extracted separately, so the pairing cannot be read from the text (taken in order the hub would be 172 m, which is clearly wrong; the hub is probably 56 m); it also predates the floater fault and redesign (the completed units are 176.1 m long), so it is not used.
why: Design-stage (2022) diagram with ambiguous label/value order; Toda/Kansai/ENEOS 2026 completion releases give only 176.1 m overall length and 80 m rotor. goto-fowind.co.jp returns 502.

note_zh: 머니투데이（2020-10 現場報導）：風機葉片長 65 m、最高 157 m，葉輪直徑 134.4 m。若以 157 m 減半徑 67.2 m 得輪轂約 90 m，但兩個數字不在同一段、「最高高度」的基準未寫明，且 134 m 葉輪只屬 20 部中的 17 部，不採用。
note_en: Money Today (Oct 2020 site report): 65 m blades, maximum height 157 m, rotor diameter 134.4 m. 157 m minus a 67.2 m radius would give a hub of about 90 m, but the two numbers are in different passages, the datum of the 'maximum height' is not stated, and the 134 m rotor covers only 17 of the 20 units, so it is not used.
why: Derived value, different passages, partial units; KOWP site and other Korean trade press have no hub height. The 2015 plan values (80/90 m) stay rejected.
